name: Vossloh AG
summary: Vossloh AG provides rail infrastructure products and services in Germany and internationally. It operates through three segments: Core Components; Customized Modules; and Lifecycle Solutions. The company provides rail fasteners for heavy-haul and high-speed lines, as well as manufacturers concrete and switch ties, and concrete elements for slab tracks and level crossing systems. It also manufactures, installs, and maintains switches and crossings, related control and monitoring systems for light-rail and high-speed applications.
